The season began on 2 August 2025.{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/key-dates-for-202526 |title=Key dates for 2025/26 |publisher=SPFL |date=13 January 2025 |access-date=31 March 2025 |archive-date=6 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250506192302/https://spfl.co.uk/news/key-dates-for-202526 |url-status=live }} Twelve teams contested the league: [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]], [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]], [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]], [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]], [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]], [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]], [[Livingston F.C.|Livingston]], [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]], [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] and [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]]. On 16 May 2026, Celtic secured a fifth consecutive Premiership title and record-breaking 56th Scottish league title overall, following a 3–1 victory at home to Heart of Midlothian on the final matchday, denying Hearts their first championship since [[1959–60 Scottish Division One|1960]] and the first non-[[Old Firm]] championship since [[1984–85 Scottish Premier Division|1985]].{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yegmxv883o|title=Riot police deal with 'serious disorder' as Celtic fans celebrate Premiership title win |date=17 May 2026 |work=BBC News |access-date=17 May 2026}}{{cite news|url= https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0m24m3nd1vo|title= Resilient Celtic time run perfectly to win race after eight-month chase|date=16 May 2026|work=BBC Sport|first=Tom|last=English|access-date=18 May 2026}} Excluding post-season playoffs in [[1890–91 Scottish Football League|1891]] and [[1904–05 Scottish Division One|1905]], it was only the third time the Scottish championship had been decided between the two contenders directly on the final matchday, after [[1964–65 Scottish Division One|1965]] (also involving Hearts) and [[1990–91 Scottish Premier Division|1991]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thenational.scot/news/26109560.celtic-v-hearts-4-final-day-scottish-title-deciders/|title=Celtic v Hearts: 4 final-day Scottish title deciders|first=Laura|last=Pollock|publisher=The National (Scotland)|date=15 May 2026|access-date=16 May 2026}}{{cite news|url=https://www.scotsman.com/sport/football/scottish-premiership/latest-premiership-news/scottish-football-braces-itself-for-an-almighty-climax-with-celtic-v-hearts-8549260|title=Scottish football braces itself for an almighty climax with Celtic v Hearts|first=Mark|last=Atkinson|publisher=The Scotsman|date=15 May 2026|access-date=16 May 2026}} ==Teams== The following teams changed division after the 2024–25 season.
